name: Clobenzorex
summary: Clobenzorex is a central nervous system stimulant and anorectic drug, chemically classified as an N-substituted amphetamine and a phenethylamine. Marketed by Aventis under the trade name Asenlix in India, Mexico, Honduras, and other parts of Latin America.

pharmacology.text: A prodrug of amphetamine, clobenzorex is metabolized within hours of ingestion into 4-hydroxyclobenzorex and, in smaller amounts, amphetamine.

uses.text: Marketed by Aventis under the trade name Asenlix in India, Mexico, Honduras, and other parts of Latin America.

sideEffects.en: Its effects are like those of amphetamine: sleeplessness, restlessness, dry mouth, loss of appetite, a fast heartbeat and raised blood pressure. It can lead to dependence, and heavy use can cause paranoia and psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 它的作用與安非他命相似：失眠、坐立不安、口乾、食慾減退、心跳加快與血壓升高。它可能導致依賴，大量使用可能造成妄想與精神病症狀。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它的作用与安非他命相似：失眠、坐立不安、口干、食欲减退、心跳加快与血压升高。它可能导致依赖，大量使用可能造成妄想与精神病症状。

fact.en: Because the body turns part of it into amphetamine, people taking clobenzorex can test positive for amphetamine on drug tests.
fact.zh: 由於身體會把它部分轉化成安非他命，服用氯苄雷司的人在藥物檢測中可能呈現安非他命陽性。
fact.zhHans: 由于身体会把它部分转化成安非他命，服用氯苄雷司的人在药物检测中可能呈现安非他命阳性。
